trustedBackendEvidence.cascadeNote: Auth-owned DELETE cascades through existing FK actions; do not infer public service DML needs from cascading rows. Exercise synthetic role/mutation proof after narrowing; hosted Auth API proof remains separate.

objectiveGuardRequirements: Enumerate all non-extension-owned public/private relations (ordinary/partitioned/foreign tables, views/materialized views, sequences) and routines, including unknown signatures; fail unknown objects before matching permissions. Extension exclusions must use pg_depend extension membership, never names or broad owner exclusions.

Require exact known object identities, relkind, expected columns, expected owner and non-Supabase-managed creation ownership. Reject app objects created under supabase_admin or owned by app-client/service/unknown roles. Do not blindly ALTER OWNER to silence failures.

Require RLS on every app table, including historical backups/private future tables. Views must retain expected security_invoker and underlying policy/column boundaries; views do not have table RLS flags. Detect disabled RLS or altered view definition/security options.

Evaluate every table privilege including SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE/REFERENCES/TRIGGER/MAINTAIN using has_table_privilege for anon/authenticated/service_role/PUBLIC. Check WITH GRANT OPTION separately.

For every non-dropped column, evaluate has_column_privilege for SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/REFERENCES and corresponding WITH GRANT OPTION. Table-level grants imply column access; checking pg_attribute.attacl alone misses these. Existing table revokes do not remove independent column grants.

Evaluate every sequence SELECT/UPDATE/USAGE and every routine EXECUTE with exact identity arguments via effective privilege functions and grant-option checks; raw ACL grantee lists alone miss PUBLIC and inherited access.

Inspect role memberships and schema effective USAGE/CREATE; fail any current/inherited app-role capability exceeding allowlist. Do not waive access because no direct ACL is present. Existing roles must not gain ownership, SUPERUSER or BYPASSRLS (except expected service bypass) outside contract.

Scan postgres/application default ACLs, including GLOBAL function EXECUTE and public/private TABLE/SEQUENCE defaults for all external roles including service_role. Record managed supabase_admin residual exactly and separately; it never excuses an unsafe app object.

Mutation-test the guard against a new overgranted app table/view/sequence/function, missing RLS, owner mismatch, column grants, PUBLIC grant, inherited-role grant, grant-option grants, service-role broad DML and unknown overload. Every case must fail; approved baseline should pass.

Run actual positive and negative role behavior for guest/current app inserts, own and other profile projection, owner/admin/nonowner delete, comments/votes/rewards/photo guards, token upsert, exact service attribution clear, notification lookup, Auth cascades, and RPC wrapper/helper calls. Catalog privilege PASS alone does not prove RLS or behavior.
An ephemeral probe object must be created only inside disposable local/staging acceptance transactions. Never create app probes on production or change managed owners merely for testing.

Proposed matrix preserves those logical capabilities; focused positives must prove narrowed column payloads. Caller presence must not be claimed.

Current source calls only log_realtime_event. Old migration comments describe direct own INSERT and manual service-role read/cleanup. Proposed minimal matrix removes them, retains RPC and postgres-owner manual operations; root should record this route narrowing in final contract, not silently claim no historical route ever existed.

Narrow INSERT to logical payload columns requires affected positive tests (fixtures may deliberately pass synthetic id/created_at; change synthetic setup rather than infer app permissions from fixtures). ON CONFLICT upserts require UPDATE of submitted conflict key fields too.

Deployed v4 source now resolved; minimal service attribution clear is known. Local role/FK tests must prove cascades with narrowed child grants, and hosted Auth acceptance must separately prove real managed Auth behavior. No Phase04 pipeline implementation authorized.

Guest INSERT retained here on flags/feedback for current capability. Final Phase03A guard allowlist must be amended after gateway architecture to deny every direct/alternate guest bypass; this review is not limiter acceptance.

Async deletion worker RPCs, photo-intent RPCs, moderation feedback columns and optional monthly leaderboard are absent baseline/deferred contracts. Do not create or grant these in FDA012. The current manifest also incorrectly names src/lib/notifications.ts; source verification uses actual files.
